verdict.rationale: Zamzar documents an official Java SDK that gives convenient access to all API features, so a developer can build against a first-party SDK. Only one language is evidenced, though. The other languages are covered by code samples, which are not SDKs. Missing for 10: official SDKs in other languages (e.g. Python, Node), detail on SDK depth or versioning, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use our official Java SDK for convenient access to all features of the API. Requires Java 8 or later.
